quotes.quote: Shawn Kemp in high school was incredible, man. Incredible to watch. Really, incredible to watch because he was so athletic. He was a 6'10" Vince Carter. The elevation, the hangtime, the explosion, all of that. He was a 6'10" Vince Carter. Just think about Vince is 6'6". Think about a 6'10" Vince Carter. He moved like a guard almost when he was in the air. He made that look sweet. The hangtime, walking through the air, all of that stuff.
quotes.why_it_matters: This quote offers a vivid comparison of Shawn Kemp's high school athleticism to a 6'10" Vince Carter, highlighting his unique physical gifts that shaped his NBA legacy.
